```{python}
from pathlib import Path
from math import sqrt,erf
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle,Patch
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent:raise RuntimeError('Projecte absent')
    root=root.parent
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':14,'svg.fonttype':'none'})
cdf=lambda x:.5*(1+erf(x/sqrt(2)))
critical=1.959963984540054;delta=3;beta=cdf(critical-delta)-cdf(-critical-delta)
assert np.isclose(2*(1-cdf(critical)),.05) and .149<beta<.150
expected_errors=[5,round(100*beta)]
assert expected_errors==[5,15]
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(9,6.3),layout='constrained')
titles=['A · Cinta ben ajustada\nDesajust mitjà real: 0 cm',
        'B · Cinta que indica de més\nDesajust mitjà real: +3 cm']
notes=['Unes 5 falses alarmes\ni 95 decisions correctes\nper cada 100 proves',
       'Uns 15 problemes no detectats\ni 85 problemes detectats\nper cada 100 proves']
for ax,errors,title,note in zip(axes,expected_errors,titles,notes):
    for i in range(100):
        row,col=divmod(i,10)
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((col,9-row),.83,.83,facecolor='#b86432' if i<errors else '#77a8c4',edgecolor='none'))
    ax.set(xlim=(-.15,10),ylim=(-2.8,10.2),aspect='equal',xticks=[],yticks=[],title=title)
    ax.text(4.9,-.45,note,ha='center',va='top',fontsize=14)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():spine.set_visible(False)
fig.suptitle('Una prova = 16 lectures del tram de 20 m',fontsize=16)
fig.legend(handles=[Patch(facecolor='#b86432',label='Decisió equivocada'),Patch(facecolor='#77a8c4',label='Decisió correcta')],
           loc='outside lower center',ncol=2,frameon=False,fontsize=14)
print('Freqüències esperades, abans d’arrodonir:',{'tipus_I':5,'tipus_II':100*beta,'potencia':100*(1-beta)})
fig.savefig(root/'assets/img/generated/errors-contrast.svg',facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None});plt.close(fig)
```
